record.paper_title: Extra extension properties of equidimensional holomorphic mappings: results and open questions
record.original_question: Prove the all-dimensional analogue of the extension results discussed in Section 3: meromorphic mappings from the Hartogs figure H_n^k(r) = Δ^n(1 − r) × Δ^k ∪ Δ^n × A^k(r, 1) into compact manifolds or spaces in the classes P_k^- and G_k should extend to Δ^{n+k} \ A, where A has Hausdorff (2n − 1)-dimensional measure zero. In particular, prove that the analogue of Theorem 3.2 should hold for meromorphic mappings between equidimensional manifolds in all dimensions.

evidence.quote: General Conjecture. Meromorphic mappings from Hkn(r) to compact (disk-convex) manifolds of class P−k should extend onto Δn+k \ A where A is of Haussdorf (2n − 1)-dimensional measure zero. If the image manifold is from class Gk then A ≠ ∅ should imply very restrictive conditions on the topology and complex structure of X (see results below).

Question 3.1 We conjecture that the analogous result should hold for meromorphic mappings in all dimensions. I.e. from Hkn(r) to compact manifolds (and spaces) in the classes P−k and Gk. In particular, Theorem 3.2 should be true for meromorphic mappings between equidimensional manifolds in all dimensions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. For positive integers $n,k$ and $0<r<1$, write $\Delta^m$ for the open unit polydisc in $\mathbb{C}^m$, $\Delta^m(s)$ for the polydisc of polyradius $s$, and $A^k(r,1) = \Delta^k \setminus \overline{\Delta^k(1-r)}$ for the spherical shell. Define the $(n,k)$-Hartogs figure
$$H^n_k(r) \;=\; \bigl(\Delta^n(1-r)\times \Delta^k\bigr) \;\cup\; \bigl(\Delta^n \times A^k(r,1)\bigr) \subset \Delta^{n+k}.$$

Let $X$ be a compact complex manifold (or, more generally, a normal complex space). Following the standard terminology, say that $X$ belongs to the class $\mathcal{P}^-_k$ if there is no nonconstant meromorphic mapping from a neighborhood of the boundary of $H^n_k(r)$ in $\Delta^{n+k}$ that fails to extend meromorphically across some compact subset of positive Hausdorff $(2n-1)$-measure into $X$ (equivalently, $X$ admits no plurinegative singular metric obstructing $k$-codimensional Hartogs extension). Say that $X$ belongs to the class $\mathcal{G}_k$ if every meromorphic mapping from $H^n_k(r)$ into $X$ extends meromorphically to $\Delta^{n+k}$ except possibly on an analytic subset.

Conjecture to prove or disprove.

(a) Let $X$ be a compact (disk-convex) complex manifold of class $\mathcal{P}^-_k$. Show that every meromorphic mapping $f \colon H^n_k(r) \to X$ extends to a meromorphic mapping
$$\tilde f \colon \Delta^{n+k} \setminus A \;\longrightarrow\; X,$$
where $A \subset \Delta^{n+k}$ has Hausdorff $(2n-1)$-dimensional measure zero.

(b) Let $X$ be a compact complex manifold of class $\mathcal{G}_k$. Show that the analogous extension holds, and moreover that nonemptiness of the exceptional set $A$ forces strong restrictions on the topology and complex structure of $X$ (in particular, $X$ must contain a rational curve, or analogous obstructions).

(c) In the equidimensional case $\dim X = n+k$, prove the corresponding extension theorem for meromorphic mappings between equidimensional complex manifolds in all dimensions $n,k \ge 1$ (the analogue, for general $n$, of the $n=1$ extension result).
artifact.status_search_result: The general all-dimensional Hartogs-type extension conjecture for meromorphic mappings from $H^n_k(r)$ into compact manifolds of class $\mathcal{P}^-_k$ and $\mathcal{G}_k$, with exceptional set of Hausdorff $(2n-1)$-measure zero, appears to remain open. Known results (Ivashkovich, Shiffman, Siu) cover the case $n=1$ (codimension-one extension across thin sets) and Kähler targets, but no proof in arbitrary $n,k$ for the stated classes appears in the literature; subsequent works on Hartogs extension in $q$-complete spaces and toric varieties address related but distinct settings.

status_evidence.title: The Hartogs-type extension theorem for meromorphic mappings into q-complete complex spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Hartogs-type extension results for meromorphic mappings, treating restricted target classes rather than the general P^-_k / G_k conjecture in all dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent extension results address related but more restrictive target classes, indicating the general conjecture remains the reference open problem.

status_evidence.title: On nonimbeddability of Hartogs figures into complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies obstructions to extension of meromorphic mappings from Hartogs figures, in line with the conjectural framework of classes P^-_k and G_k.
status_evidence.claim: The framework of the conjecture continues to be cited as an open program.
